chunks: And al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated it from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀṣim, similarly.

key_terms.أَبَانِ: Abān, a narrator transmitting the report
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنُ: al-Ḥusayn, the first named transmitter in this chain
key_terms.الْقَاسِمِ: al-Qāsim, an intermediary narrator in the chain
key_terms.رَوَاهُ: narrated it; indicates transmission of the hadith
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: ʿAbd Allāh, the final named narrator here
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: similarly; meaning the wording or meaning is the same as the previous report

ai.seo_question: What is the narrator chain for this version of the hadith in al-Istibṣār?
ai.summary: This report provides an alternative chain of transmission for the same preceding hadith. It indicates that al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated the same report through al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀṣim.
